title: Deliver candid investment assessment
description: Synthesize evidence into a blunt but calibrated assessment of LICHEN as an engineering research effort and as a product; recommend bounded validation gates before further scale spending.
acceptance_criteria: User receives an explicit verdict, strongest reasons for and against, limitations of available cost and field data, and falsifiable next-spend criteria.
notes: Synthesis: Core IPv6/SCHC/CoAP low-rate mesh premise is technically credible; real bench and secure software integration are valuable. Current evidence supports a prototype, not validated dense/mobile/commercial deployment. Main risk is breadth and integration/review churn ahead of a repeatable production-configured vertical slice. Idealized city simulation assumes hop success and omits duty gating; phone chat uses timer-generated delivery state; CCP receiver-aware wire contract is gated, not deployed. Account-wide usage rose 1658.26 USD over about 24h, without project attribution, so exact waste cannot be quantified. A concrete waste-alarm baseline defect is tracked separately as lh2z; budget policy and fleet state left unchanged. Standards claims overreach custom Schnorr/link/EDHOC profile; current Meshtastic official docs distinguish authenticated modern DMs from unauthenticated channel traffic. Gateway service design at 15/75 USD per gateway-month needs demand/support-cost validation, not just infrastructure estimates. Recommendation: freeze breadth/volume purchase, fixed spend/time budget, existing hardware forced multi-hop secure real-client slice then 10-20-node day-long trial with declared load, delivery/latency/energy/recovery metrics and equivalent competitor baseline; require outside users and willingness to pay before commercial scale. No code, tests, hardware or fleet operations performed.
close_reason: Evidence synthesis complete: explicit technical/product/spending verdict, measured-versus-planned distinctions, financial attribution limits, and falsifiable next-spend gates prepared for final response.
